raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Main fuses aiter's stage-1 MXFP8 quant (`fused_dynamic_mxfp8_quant_moe_sort`) into the small MoE sort only when `hidden % 2048 == 0`, and its bitonic sort kernel (#44004) runs only without the quant. DeepSeek-V4.1 has hidden 5120, so in decode it runs the sort and the quant as separate launches in every MoE layer.

This PR fuses the quant for hidden sizes that are multiples of 1024, also in the bitonic kernel. For DeepSeek-V4.1 (E 385 = 384 routed + 1 fused shared expert, top 7), the sort and the quant become one launch up to 36 rows.

The stage-1 quant runs only when aiter uses fp8 activations. With aiter's default `AITER_BF16_FP8_MOE_BOUND` (256), decode uses bf16 activations, and this PR changes nothing. The DeepSeek-V4.1 cookbook sets it to 0, as do all results below.

## Modifications

The branch is based on main `a126e8d640`, which has #44004's bitonic sort (merged 2026-10-16; it replaced #41900, which the old head `10b76d8c07` used). The diff is kernel +85/-16 and tests +118/-8.

- `moe_sorting_small.py`: the `fused_moe` gate passes the activations to the sort when `hidden % 1024 == 0` (was 2048). The bitonic kernel gets the quant: extra programs write each token's fp8 row once and the e8m0 scales of its pairs at aiter's swizzled addresses, with aiter's math.
- Above 32 pairs and below 512 experts, the quant path now takes the bitonic kernel. From 512 experts on, it keeps main's kernels: at Qwen3.5's E 513 / top 11, the bitonic kernel with the quant was 4.7 to 5.2 % slower at 3 to 5 rows.
- `test_moe_sorting_small.py`: E 385 / top 7 in the sort test; quant bytes and scales checked bitwise against aiter at hidden 5120; the 36 / 37-row cutoff; and a new `test_fused_moe_a8w4_stage1_matches_aiter`. The new test runs aiter `fused_moe` at DeepSeek-V4.1's TP4 shape (target MoE and DSpark draft MoE). It fails if the quant did not come from the sort, and it compares the stage-1 output bitwise with stock aiter.

Credit: the sort kernel is from #44004. The end-to-end test follows the idea of #43822's test.

## Accuracy Tests

Unit tests on one MI355X, image `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.21-rocm720-mi35x-20261009`, AITER `cc1773508c`:

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| This PR, whole test file | Passed (6 tests, 21 s) |
| End-to-end test on main | Failed as intended: `E=385 m=1: the sort did not emit the quant` |
| End-to-end test on main + #43822 | Failed as intended: `E=385 m=36: the sort did not emit the quant` |

Serving accuracy, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, TP4, one run per arm: same image and AITER, main `4afae5568b` with the open #44601 merged locally, shared-expert fusion on, `AITER_BF16_FP8_MOE_BOUND=0`. The quant output is bitwise equal to aiter's, so these runs only check the integration.

| Benchmark | main | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| GSM8K (1,314 scored questions) | 1275 (0.970) | 1277 (0.972) |
| GPQA Diamond (198 questions) | 169 (0.854) | 168 (0.848) |
| NIAH single_2, 64k and 128k | 1.0 | 1.0 |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

### Serving: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, TP4, random dataset

| Setup | Value |
|---|---|
| Runs | same versions as the accuracy runs; 4 sessions per arm, 2 on each GPU group, in alternating order; the PR's kernel file before the 512-expert rule (same kernels at E 385) |
| Workload | 1k or 8k input, 1k output, 1 to 64 users, no speculative decoding; radix cache off; cache flushed before each point |
| Patch active | 1 to 32 users (one batch row per user, within the 36-row limit); 64 users is the control |
| Cell | mean over the sessions; "same" means the change is not larger than both arms' spread and 1 % |
| Left out | points where SGLang compiled a Triton kernel during the measured run; 1k / 64 users keeps 1 session per arm, and this PR keeps 3 at 1k / 4 and 8k / 8 users |

At 1 to 32 users, median TPOT is 1.5 to 2.6 % lower (beyond the spread at 11 of 12 points). Output throughput is 1.8 to 2.4 % higher at the 6 points beyond the spread. At 64 users, all changes are within 0.4 %.

| Input | Users | TPOT main (ms) | TPOT this PR (ms) | TPOT change | Throughput change |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1k | 1 | 5.28 | 5.17 | -2.0 % | +2.3 % (same) |
| 1k | 2 | 5.60 | 5.48 | -2.1 % | +2.1 % |
| 1k | 4 | 5.83 | 5.71 | -2.1 % | +2.3 % |
| 1k | 8 | 6.65 | 6.52 | -2.0 % | +2.1 % |
| 1k | 16 | 8.24 | 8.09 | -1.9 % | +1.8 % |
| 1k | 32 | 10.43 | 10.20 | -2.2 % | +2.0 % (same) |
| 1k | 64 (control) | 14.35 | 14.34 | -0.1 % (same) | +0.4 % (same) |
| 8k | 1 | 5.29 | 5.19 | -1.8 % | +9.2 % (same) |
| 8k | 2 | 5.64 | 5.49 | -2.6 % | +2.4 % |
| 8k | 4 | 5.86 | 5.75 | -2.0 % | +1.9 % |
| 8k | 8 | 6.76 | 6.66 | -1.5 % | +0.9 % (same) |
| 8k | 16 | 8.68 | 8.47 | -2.4 % | +3.0 % (same) |
| 8k | 32 | 11.77 | 11.50 | -2.3 % (same) | +2.0 % (same) |
| 8k | 64 (control) | 16.54 | 16.59 | +0.3 % (same) | -0.3 % (same) |

### Kernels: one MI355X, main vs main + #43822 vs this PR

Timed with `triton.testing.do_bench_cudagraph`: median of 6 samples per point, in the order main, main + #43822, this PR, this PR, main + #43822, main. "main + #43822" is main with only #43822's `moe_sorting_small.py` change (head `60a6a21555`) merged in, not #43822's head. "Same" follows the rule above.

At E 385 / top 7, this PR makes the sort + quant 46 to 59 % faster than main at 1 to 36 rows, and the whole MoE layer 3.4 to 10.0 % faster. Against main + #43822, it is the same at 1 to 4 rows and faster at 5 to 36 rows: 20 to 63 % for the sort + quant and 2.0 to 6.5 % for the layer.

Sort + quant, us per call (launches: main / main + #43822 / this PR):

| Rows | main | main + #43822 | This PR | Launches | vs main | vs main + #43822 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 4.68 | 2.11 | 2.11 | 2 / 1 / 1 | -54.9 % | same |
| 4 | 5.71 | 2.97 | 2.96 | 2 / 1 / 1 | -48.1 % | same |
| 5 | 6.88 | 4.62 | 3.71 | 2 / 1 / 1 | -46.1 % | -19.7 % |
| 10 | 8.21 | 9.36 | 4.29 | 2 / 1 / 1 | -47.7 % | -54.1 % |
| 17 | 9.37 | 11.59 | 4.43 | 2 / 3 / 1 | -52.7 % | -61.8 % |
| 36 | 12.58 | 14.07 | 5.21 | 2 / 3 / 1 | -58.6 % | -62.9 % |
| 37 | 14.10 | 14.12 | 14.12 | 3 / 3 / 3 | same | same |

Whole MoE layer (`fused_moe` A8W4, intermediate 576 padded to 640), us per call:

| Rows | main | main + #43822 | This PR | vs main | vs main + #43822 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 25.03 | 22.57 | 22.54 | -10.0 % | same |
| 5 | 42.60 | 40.37 | 39.59 | -7.1 % | -2.0 % |
| 10 | 73.61 | 74.55 | 69.69 | -5.3 % | -6.5 % |
| 24 | 123.37 | 125.49 | 118.29 | -4.1 % | -5.7 % |
| 36 | 165.66 | 168.79 | 160.07 | -3.4 % | -5.2 % |
| 40 | 179.04 | 181.90 | 180.38 | same | same |

Other shapes:

| Shape | Rows | Sort + quant vs main | Sort + quant vs main + #43822 | Whole layer vs main |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| DSpark draft MoE, E 129 / top 4, hidden 5120 | 1 to 32 | -49 to -60 % | same at 1 and 8 rows; -38 and -52 % at 16 and 32 | -6.8 to -8.2 % at 8 to 32 rows (1 row: same, main's spread 12.5 %) |
| DeepSeek-V3, E 257 / top 9, hidden 7168 | 1 to 28 | -43 to -58 % | same at 1 row; -29 to -62 % at 4 to 28 | not measured |
| E 129 / top 5, hidden 4096 (main already fuses) | 7 to 51 | -30 to -64 % | -30 to -64 % | same at 1 to 7 rows; -5.3 % at 8 |
| Qwen3.5, E 513 / top 11, hidden 4096 | 1 to 8 | same (same kernels as main) | same | same |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (No documentation change.)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (Accuracy, serving and kernel timings above.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -15,6 +15,7 @@
 
 import functools
 import logging
+import math
 from contextvars import ContextVar
 
 import torch
@@ -294,7 +295,8 @@ def _moe_sorting_small_kernel_distributed(
             tl.store(qscale_ptr + sw, exp.to(tl.uint8))
 
 
-# no-quant path: histogram + bitonic sort keep every pair in registers of one CTA
+# histogram + bitonic sort keep every pair in registers of one CTA; with EMIT_MX, one quant CTA
+# per (token, column chunk) writes the fp8 row once and the scale bytes of all its pairs
 @triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["M", "moe_buf_numel", "num_buf"])
 def _moe_sorting_small_kernel_sorted(
     topk_ids_ptr,  # [M, topk] i32
@@ -305,17 +307,25 @@ def _moe_sorting_small_kernel_sorted(
     num_valid_ids_ptr,  # [2] i32
     moe_buf_ptr,
     moe_buf_numel,
+    qx_ptr,  # [M, N_COLS] activations to mx-quantize (EMIT_MX only)
+    qout_ptr,  # [M, N_COLS] fp8 out
+    qscale_ptr,  # swizzled e8m0 bytes, one per (sorted_row, group)
     M,
     TOPK: tl.constexpr,
+    TOPK_POW2: tl.constexpr,
     BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
     P_POW2: tl.constexpr,  # >= M * topk
     E_POW2: tl.constexpr,  # > num_experts; bin E_POW2 - 1 holds the inactive lanes
     PAD_POW2: tl.constexpr,  # >= (M * topk) * BLOCK_SIZE (worst-case padded len)
     BUF_BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
     num_buf,  # buf-zero CTAs occupy pids [1, num_buf]
+    EMIT_MX: tl.constexpr,
+    N_COLS: tl.constexpr,
+    QCHUNK: tl.constexpr,
+    SCALEN_PAD: tl.constexpr,
 ):
     pid = tl.program_id(0)
-    if pid > 0:
+    if pid > 0 and pid <= num_buf:
         offs = (pid - 1) * BUF_BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BUF_BLOCK)
         tl.store(
             moe_buf_ptr + offs,
@@ -330,8 +340,52 @@ def _moe_sorting_small_kernel_sorted(
     offs_e = tl.arange(0, E_POW2)
     cnt = tl.where(offs_e < E_POW2 - 1, tl.histogram(e, E_POW2), 0)
     blocks = (cnt + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) // BLOCK_SIZE
+    # first padded row of each expert
+    start = (tl.cumsum(blocks, 0) - blocks) * BLOCK_SIZE
+
+    if EMIT_MX and pid > num_buf:
+        # quant CTA: token t, columns [c0, c0 + QCHUNK); math as fused_dynamic_mxfp8_quant_moe_sort
+        q_id = pid - num_buf - 1
+        CHUNKS: tl.constexpr = N_COLS // QCHUNK
+        t = q_id // CHUNKS
+        c0 = (q_id % CHUNKS) * QCHUNK
+        offs_k = tl.arange(0, TOPK_POW2)
+        mask_k = offs_k < TOPK
+        pk = t * TOPK + offs_k
+        ek = tl.load(topk_ids_ptr + pk, mask=mask_k, other=0)
+        # stable rank of each of the token's pairs within its expert
+        same = (e[None, :] == ek[:, None]) & (offs_p[None, :] < pk[:, None])
+        dest = tl.gather(start, ek, 0) + tl.sum(tl.where(same, 1, 0), axis=1)
+
+        offs_q = tl.arange(0, QCHUNK)
+        x = tl.load(qx_ptr + t * N_COLS + c0 + offs_q).to(tl.float32)
+        x2 = tl.reshape(x, (QCHUNK // 32, 32))
+        amax = tl.maximum(tl.max(tl.abs(x2), axis=1), 1e-10)
+        sf = amax * (1.0 / 448.0)
+        bits = sf.to(tl.int32, bitcast=True)
+        exp = (bits >> 23) & 0xFF
